use_when: a legacy AAOP instruction or installed consumer still names agent-bundles and needs a safe migration path to the current Task Pod role-source policy
avoid_when: the main agent or a project-local role can perform the responsibility
a bounded missing role can be sourced directly from the current reviewed agency-agents-zh provider
the missing capability is a tool/API/runtime/credential/authorization/product-decision gap

minimal_commands: do not install or clone YuemingHub/agent-bundles for new AAOP work
load the AAOP team-construction policy and the agency-agents-zh Integration Recipe only if a bounded specialist role is genuinely missing
use agency-orchestrator separately only when the justified Task Pod needs delegated DAG/resume execution that the host cannot provide
notes: RETIRED compatibility tombstone. This Recipe intentionally contains no agent-bundles bootstrap/install command and no runtime dependency on the YuemingHub/agent-bundles repository.

The historical repository was a cross-host installer for curated role prompts. AAOP v1 now owns Task Pod composition and can select a current reviewed role source directly, so keeping another installer layer no longer adds a distinct capability.
Legacy consumers may resolve this Recipe during migration, but the result is a redirect to current AAOP Task Pod/provider selection rather than a fresh agent-bundles adoption.
Role prompts still do not create missing APIs, tools, credentials, network access, or runtime capabilities.

checks: confirm no new project or host configuration was written by agent-bundles
confirm the required specialist responsibility is represented by an AAOP Task Pod with one accountable owner
if an external role source is still justified, confirm the current reviewed provider/revision is recorded directly rather than through agent-bundles
confirm a technical capability gap was not misclassified as a need for more roles

steps: for legacy installations only, remove agent files using the ownership evidence from that historical installation without deleting project-owned or pre-existing roles
remove any obsolete local clone/reference to YuemingHub/agent-bundles after migration
continue from AAOP Task Pod/provider-selection state without the retired installer layer

warnings: Do not newly install agent-bundles. This file exists only so historical AAOP references fail safe during migration.
Use agency-agents-zh only when a concrete bounded specialist responsibility is missing; do not replace one broad role catalog with another broad default install.
Use agency-orchestrator only for a distinct proven Task Pod DAG/resume execution gap; a role source and a delegated execution runtime are separate capability classes.
